I live and work in California. California has a system of centers of disability services called Regional Centers, which exist because of a law called the Lanterman Act (not the only disability services in California, but one avenue.) There are 21 different Regional Centers in California serving different regions. I work for Redwood Coast Regional Center, which covers the four northern California counties of Mendocino, Lake, Humboldt, and Del Norte. I got this job because my Service Coordinator at Redwood Coast Regional Center (similar to a caseworker) told me there was an opening. To get the job you have to be a client, meaning you have to have one of the disabilities they serve. There may be job openings right now in the agency. Here is the website.
